item.title: Ramsar Wetland Sites source files
item.subtitle: Designated & Protected Sites / DAERA, Northern Ireland Environment Agency
item.description: Wetlands of international importance designated under the 1971 Ramsar Convention on Wetlands. The 20 NI Ramsar sites cover loughs, estuaries and bogs of internationally significant ecological character.
